survey.title: 南山圖軸
survey.inscription: “癸亥（天啓三年，1623,32 歲）六月大師相岵翁
survey.note: 此鑫是爲岵翁祝壽之作，岵翁爲大司馬，王時敏

opinions.text: 此是代筆畫，款是真的，王時敏時年三十二歲，這麼早就請人代筆是絕無僅有的，没有第二個例子，王牽就没有這個資格，是松江畫。謝稚柳、啓功、楊仁愷等：不同意。
opinions.text_en: This is a ghost-painting; the signature is genuine. Wang Shimin was thirty-two at the time; having someone ghost-paint this early is unique, there is no second example; Wang Hui did not have that standing [then]. It is a Songjiang painting. Xie Zhiliu, Qi Gong, Yang Renkai and others: disagree.
opinions.doubt: 王牽 read as 王翬 Wang Hui — check the source

survey.title: 等倣佔山水圖冊（十開）
survey.note: 册内係王翬師生之作。其中顧昉、徐玫、楊晉煮

opinions.text: 顧昉和楊管最頻王肇風格，但顧昉畫筆較軟，習性稍有不同，不如楊晉。王雲與蕭展一起屬金陵派，後跟王肇學，稍變其法，功力深，格調不离。古語說，弟子不必不如師，然這衰老師太高明了，那麽就改爲弟子必不如師了。
opinions.text_en: Gu Fang and Yang Guan most resemble Wang Hui's style, but Gu Fang's brushwork is softer and his habits slightly different; he is not as good as Yang Jin. Wang Yun, together with Xiao Chen, belonged to the Jinling school; later he studied with Wang Hui and changed his method slightly; deep skill, the tone not ... . An old saying has it that the pupil need not be inferior to the master; but here the master is so brilliant that it becomes: the pupil must be inferior to the master.
opinions.doubt: 王肇 read as 王翬 Wang Hui; 楊管 as given (perhaps OCR for 楊晉); 格調不离 unclear (perhaps 不高 'not high'); 衰 read as 裏

opinions.text: 話不能這麼說，弟子可以超過老師，但不能走老師的路子，八大的例子就是他死學董其昌（按：這裹可能指山水）。
opinions.text_en: You can't put it that way: a pupil can surpass the teacher, but must not follow the teacher's path. Bada's example: he slavishly learned Dong Qichang (note: this probably refers to landscape).
opinions.doubt: 衰 read as 裏

opinions.text: 水份太多了，時間一長顏色就淡了。

opinions.text: 此圖爲李醉石所畫，原作在上海博物館，係送王單六十毒。此款爲徐俊鄉所作。李醉石和徐俊卿都是近代做王原祁假童的高手。
opinions.text_en: This picture was painted by Li Zuishi; the original is in the Shanghai Museum, made as a sixtieth-birthday gift for Wang Hui(?). This signature was made by Xu Junqing. Li Zuishi and Xu Junqing were both modern masters at faking Wang Yuanqi paintings.
opinions.doubt: 送王單六十毒 read as 送王翬六十壽 'for Wang Hui's sixtieth birthday' — uncertain; 徐俊鄉 read as 徐俊卿; 童 read as 畫

opinions.text_en: This painting has an inscription by 'Huang Xuan' of Suzhou, with the character xuan 玄 deleted. In Kangxi times xuan was a taboo character; usually, when written on its own, xuan was written with a dot missing. When 玄 is part of another character, the dot need not be left out.

opinions.text: 宋駿業是領銜畫家，一般畫南巡圖不暑名款，有皇帝的像，不敢署款。
opinions.text_en: Song Junye was the lead painter. Southern Inspection Tour paintings generally carry no signatures: they include the emperor's likeness, so [the painters] dared not sign.

opinions.text: 此件是從溥儀手裹出來的，那麼這些圖章應該在官裹打僞印章。既不是宋駿業，也不是王翬所畫，是一般工匠畫的，宋駿業還帶些文人畫的味道。
opinions.text_en: This piece came out of Puyi's hands, so these seals would have to be forged seals stamped inside the palace. It was painted neither by Song Junye nor by Wang Hui but by an ordinary artisan; Song Junye still has something of the literati flavor.
opinions.doubt: 官裹 read as 宮裏 'in the palace'; the seal sentence is ambiguous — check the source

opinions.text_en: In his later period he enlarged his brush and painted rather boldly and roughly. In the Anhui school only his brushwork is respectable, quite different from the cautious, fine, sinewy lines of the Anhui school. opinions.text: 啓功當時說王翬有摹本，因此畫要早，可能就是倪瓚所作。
opinions.text_en: Qi Gong said at the time that Wang Hui had made a tracing copy, so this painting must be earlier; it may be by Ni Zan himself.

opinions.text: 我不相信王翬，董其昌看不出此畫是假的，此圖風格完全不像，遵反了倪雲林的性格，稿子是他的，是調包了，後面題跋都真，此畫是硬做硬描的。
opinions.text_en: I don't believe Wang Hui and Dong Qichang couldn't see this painting was fake. The style is completely unlike, going against Ni Yunlin's character; the composition is his, but it has been switched; the colophons after it are all genuine; this painting was forcibly fabricated and traced.
I agree with this view.

survey.title: 約齋圖卷
survey.note: 此畫應爲周臣所作。款字爲後添。

opinions.text: 此畫上下左右都裁了，就是爲了拼題頭，畫應是周臣風格，款是假的，畫與題是後配的，卷中跋也是真的，應寫成明人畫約齋圖，偽唐寅款，畫風爲周東部。
opinions.text_en: This painting has been trimmed on all four sides, precisely to fit the title piece. The painting should be in Zhou Chen's style; the signature is fake; the painting and the inscription were put together later; the colophons in the scroll are genuine too. It should be catalogued as 'Ming anonymous, Yuezhai picture, with a forged Tang Yin signature; the painting style is Zhou Dongcun's.'
opinions.doubt: 周東部 is OCR for 周東邨 Zhou Dongcun (Zhou Chen)

opinions.text: 畫與題不是後配，應爲一起的，肯定是周臣的，應該平反。
opinions.text_en: The painting and the inscription were not put together later; they belong together; it is definitely Zhou Chen's; it should be rehabilitated.

survey.note_en: This painting should be by Zhou Chen. The signature characters were added later.

survey.title: 奔犢圖卷
survey.inscription: “正統戍辰（十三年，1448）六月二十有五日也”
survey.note: 鄧陽從不知是何許人，鄧氏家譜譜系爲：鄧洵 李嵩款係僞。畫中有“仇遠”白文印，存疑。“兩 查原故宫（周刊）書畫集也有陳琳一開。 此圖卷甚爲疲破。 卷後戴凱之撰竹譜，由兵部郎中沈爲忠書。

opinions.text: 奠璃、倪中題似不好。然身期手建而芝新道多
opinions.text_en: The inscriptions by Dian Li (?) and Ni Zhong (?) seem not good.
opinions.doubt: names garbled by OCR (奠璃, 倪中; perhaps 倪瓚 Ni Zan); the rest of the line (然身期手建而芝新道多) is unreadable — check the source

opinions.text: “御書”、“紫殿御書寶”似畫出來的。
opinions.text_en: The seals 'Yushu' (imperial calligraphy) and 'Zidian yushu bao' (treasure of imperial calligraphy of the Purple Hall) look as if they were drawn by hand.

opinions.text: 唯有“宣和中秘”章是真的。
opinions.text_en: Only the 'Xuanhe zhongmi' seal is genuine.

opinions.text: 前一段畫是真，後一段是偶，草的畫法差，是臨本。
opinions.text_en: The first section of painting is genuine; the latter section is a forgery — the grass is poorly painted; it is a copy.
opinions.doubt: reads 偶, which makes no sense alone; almost certainly OCR for 僞 'forgery' — check the source

opinions.text: 两段都是真的，草的畫法真，是一樣。大
opinions.text_en: Both sections are genuine; the way the grass is painted is genuine and the same.
opinions.doubt: stray character 大 at the end

opinions.text: 畫是两幅，畫法一致，表現形式不同，後者裝飾性更强，前者寫實性强。
opinions.text_en: There are two paintings, with the same method but different forms: the latter more decorative, the former more realistic.

opinions.text: 拖尾紙上的章是真的，两段題跋係偽，原來有的。
opinions.text_en: The seals on the end paper are genuine; the two colophons are forgeries; there originally were colophons there.

opinions.text: 清河鲁費舫上有記載，是鄧杞題，内容基本相似。劉九庵；两幅草的畫法相近。
opinions.text_en: It is recorded in the 'Qinghe shuhua fang'; it is Deng Qi's inscription, the content basically similar. Liu Jiu'an: the grass in the two paintings is painted in a similar way.
opinions.doubt: 清河鲁費舫 read as 清河書畫舫; 鄧杞 as given

opinions.text_en: The signature isn't good either; never mind the painting.
opinions.doubt: 董 read as 畫 'painting' (OCR)

survey.inscription_en: “Zhengtong wuchen year (13th year, 1448), the sixth month, the 25th day”
survey.note_en: It is not known who Deng Yangcong was; the Deng family genealogy runs: Deng Xun … The Li Song signature is forged. In the painting there is a 'Qiu Yuan' white-character seal; doubtful. 'Two … The former Palace Museum (weekly) painting and calligraphy collection also has a leaf by Chen Lin. This handscroll is very damaged. At the end of the handscroll is Dai Kaizhi's Zhupu (Treatise on bamboo), written out by Shen Weizhong, Director in the Ministry of War.
survey.note_doubt: Several notes run together. 查原 read as 查; 疲破 taken as 破 'damaged'.
survey.title_en: Galloping calves, handscroll

opinions.text: 董如文家畫派，但畫不高。梁孜，明人，廣東順德人，字思伯，人稱之浮山，官禮部主事，粱儲之孫。能詩，善書，楷書得文徽明法，童山水出董源、吴鎮，雜得文氏三之一。
opinions.text_en: The painting is like the Wen school, but not of high quality. Liang Zi, a Ming man from Shunde in Guangdong, courtesy name Sibo, called Fushan, served as a secretary in the Ministry of Rites, grandson of Liang Chu. He wrote poetry and was good at calligraphy; his regular script took Wen Zhengming's method; his landscapes derive from Dong Yuan and Wu Zhen, with about a third of the Wen manner mixed in.
opinions.doubt: 董/童 read as 畫; the biography of Liang Zi reads like a compiler's note rather than Xu's spoken remark — check the source

opinions.text: 我以前一直認爲，署此款爲他較早年之作，後見他五十餘歲之作，也有此款，復知不然。
opinions.text_en: I always used to think that works with this signature were from his relatively early years; later I saw works from his fifties with this signature too, and knew that wasn't so.

opinions.text: 他用“道復”款是很晚很晚了，没有多少年。用的，此山水較北京市文物局那開花卉的時期要晚。
opinions.text_en: He used the signature 'Daofu' only very, very late, and not for many years. This landscape is later than that flower leaf at the Beijing Municipal Cultural Relics Bureau.
opinions.doubt: '用的' after the first sentence looks like a repeated fragment and is left out; 'Daofu' presumably Chen Daofu

survey.inscription: “癸卯（康熙二年，1663）冬病中⋯•識於牛頭山，
survey.note: 此圖乃細筆山水。鑑定初期，諸老偶有戲謔之

opinions.text: 二十年前我已看過，已收錄到《古書畫過眼要録》去了。
opinions.text_en: I saw it twenty years ago; it's already recorded in 'Gu shuhua guoyan yaolu'.

opinions.text: 上半段畫得很特殊，底下老脾氣又出來了，爲什麼癸卵款的特多？
opinions.text_en: The upper half is painted very unusually; at the bottom his old habits come out again. Why are there so many signed guimao?
opinions.doubt: 癸卵 is OCR for 癸卯

opinions.text: 他經常生病的。“幽棲”是寺，“借雲”是房，寺裹的房。
opinions.text_en: He was often ill. 'Youqi' is the temple and 'Jieyun' the room — a room in the temple.

opinions.text: 等於石濤的“一枝閣”，傅抱石把他搞成一枝竹就鬧笑話了，鬧笑話可以，但鬧得太大了。程青溪與他甚好，題衰談到。
opinions.text_en: It is the same as Shitao's 'Yizhi ge' (Single Branch Pavilion); Fu Baoshi made it into a single branch of bamboo, and that made a joke of it — a joke is fine, but this was too big a joke. Cheng Qingxi was very close to him; the inscription mentions it.
opinions.doubt: 題衰 read as 題裏 'in the inscription'

opinions.text: 他不講衛生，深居簡出，難得出來，也是程青溪要他出去才洗一次澡。
opinions.text_en: He was not clean; he lived in seclusion and rarely came out; only when Cheng Qingxi wanted him to go out did he take a bath.

opinions.text: 此人很本份，與程青溪的關係，也是程青溪找上門的。
opinions.text_en: This man was very proper; as for his relationship with Cheng Qingxi, it was Cheng Qingxi who came calling on him.

opinions.text: 也有可能是一件真童。當時没落款，而後再補加的。但此畫儘管有水準，看來還是不對的。一般蔡魏公藏的王肇畫，大多均爲代筆。
opinions.text_en: It may also be a genuine painting, unsigned at the time and signed later. But although this painting has quality, it still seems not right. Generally the Wang Hui paintings collected by Cai Weigong are mostly ghost-painted.
opinions.doubt: 童 read as 畫; 王肇 read as 王翬 Wang Hui

survey.title: 山水圖軸
survey.note: 此童無年款，風格少見，特别署“基馬遠筆意”更

opinions.text: 此童尚需研究，這種書款確係少見，不能一下子就决定它的真僞，因爲看得太快。入目厲“圆録”不適宜，如作爲個人研究，倒是十分重要的資料。
opinions.text_en: This painting still needs study; this kind of signature is indeed rare; we can't decide right away whether it is genuine or fake, because we looked too quickly. It isn't suitable to include it in the catalog, but for individual research it is very important material.
opinions.doubt: 童 read as 畫; 入目厲“圆録” read as 入目爲“圖録” 'include in the (illustrated) catalog' — check the source

survey.note: 很好的資料。侯桐曾、黄左田等章僞。 紙較新。 此圖徐邦達認爲代筆，並說已寫到他的叢書衰

opinions.text: 此畫後添款，可能是陳嘉言所作，畫格很係，張應昇跋也假。
opinions.text_en: The signature on this painting was added later; possibly made by Chen Jiayan; the quality of the painting is very ...; Zhang Yingsheng's colophon is fake too.
opinions.doubt: 畫格很係 is unclear (perhaps 很低 'very low') — check the source

opinions.text: 臺中有“繡水小范”，是否他的畫可以研究。
opinions.text_en: On the painting there is 'Xiushui Xiao Fan'; whether it is his painting is worth studying.
opinions.doubt: 臺 read as 畫 'painting' (OCR)

opinions.text: 此瀬畫把款切掉，倒是很好的一張明人晝。
opinions.text_en: This kind of painting, with the signature cut off, is actually a very good Ming painting.
opinions.doubt: 瀬 read as 類; 晝 read as 畫

opinions.text_en: The signature is genuine; the boats are painted quite well too.
Also good.
Also good.

opinions.text: 此件我當它代筆，作馬反面教材。後面長跋琵琶行記全文真，越寫越好。
opinions.text_en: I treat this piece as ghost-painted, as a negative teaching example. The long colophon after it, the full text of the 'Pipa xing', is genuine, and gets better as it goes.

opinions.text: 可見這些箋都是日本紙，他在紙上木刻印花，印上自製箋的字樣，他很厲害，不僅刻木刻製箋，還刻硯等。
opinions.text_en: So these papers are all Japanese paper; he printed woodblock designs on them, with his own stationery name. He was very capable: he not only carved woodblocks to make stationery but carved inkstones and more.

survey.inscription_en: “Longqing renshen year (6th year, 1572, age 65)” “Daoji” “Qianlong 3rd year, wuwu (as read; 1738, age 56), the third day of the new moon, Nanzhuo shanren (Mountain Man of Nanzhuo)…”
survey.note_en: Very good reference material. The seals of Hou Tongzeng, Huang Zuotian and others are forgeries. The paper is rather new. Xu Bangda thinks this picture was ghost-painted, and says he has already written it into his series of books

opinions.text: 元朝畫，風格按近於趙孟堅。
opinions.text_en: A Yuan painting; the style is close to Zhao Mengjian.
opinions.doubt: 按近 read as 接近

opinions.text: 相信是趙子固。未 無款 洛神賦圖卷真迹、精
opinions.text_en: I believe it is Zhao Zigu.
opinions.doubt: stray text after the remark (catalog line): 'Song, anonymous, Nymph of the Luo River, handscroll; genuine, fine'

opinions.text: 好極了。當時張珩對我有誤解。
opinions.text_en: Superb. Zhang Heng misunderstood me at the time.

opinions.text: 當時我看不好，張珩是想把此畫賣掉。
opinions.text_en: At the time I didn't think it was good; Zhang Heng wanted to sell this painting.
The two inscriptions by Qiu Yuan and Liu Ji are forgeries.

opinions.text: 我看到北宋，款不去管它。
opinions.text_en: I'd put it at the Northern Song; never mind the signature.

opinions.text: 也是楊仁愷從東北送來的。
opinions.text_en: This one too was sent by Yang Renkai from the Northeast.
This painting may go back to the Northern Song.
